SELECT d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.is_public_holiday, d.holiday_name, r.receipts, r.units_sold, r.net_sales_before_returns, x.lines, x.units, x.net
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=107
LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) lines, sum(quantity) units, sum(net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.store_key=12 GROUP BY 1) x ON x.sale_date=d.calendar_date
